title: Time Clock user is blocked from the Staff and Roles API
custom_preconds:
1. A user is signed in with the system Time Clock role (Work Orders View, Schedule View, Timesheets View; View Mode none; every other permission OFF; read-only, can clock in/out).
  2. You have a way to send API requests to the backend (api.staging.shopview.com) as that signed-in Time Clock user.
custom_expected:
Both requests return 403 Forbidden.

Reason: the Time Clock role has no Settings / staff-administration access.
evidence: API live-probe 2026-07-13 (STAGING) as Time Clock role (be58f381): GET /api/organizations/{org}/roles , /api/staff -> expected 403, actual 403 => Correctly blocked.
source: API — Time Clock Role Enforcement probe (Jira: BE Time Clock Role Permissions Not Properly Enforced)
